jobs.title: Night Hospital Security Officer - Visitor & Access Control
jobs.description:
Texas Children's Hospital in Houston is seeking a full-time night shift NCSO Security Officer to maintain a safe environment for patients, visitors and staff.

You will staff posts, monitor access, document logs, and respond to emergencies, working as a visible deterrent and coordinating with security leadership.

Candidates should have a High School diploma, BLS, NCSO and Texas Driver's License, with a year of security or related experience.

jobs.title: Healthcare Security
jobs.description: CommonSpirit Health in Houston, Texas, is hiring a Security Officer to maintain safety and security by patrolling assigned areas and investigating suspicious activities. You will monitor electronic surveillance equipment, respond to incidents, and assist patients and visitors. jobs.title: Hospital Security Officer – Safety & Patient Care
jobs.description:
Memorial Hermann Health System is seeking a professional security officer to protect patients, staff and visitors across Memorial Hermann campuses. You will patrol, monitor access points, respond to incidents and maintain a safe environment in line with hospital policies.

The role requires vigilance, clear communication in English, and the ability to use computer systems for reporting. Candidates must meet licensing requirements and be ready to work flexible shifts.

jobs.title: Hospital Security Officer: Patient Safety & Response
jobs.description:
Houston Methodist is seeking a Security Officer to maintain a safe environment for patients, staff and visitors. The role includes patrolling premises, monitoring surveillance, and assisting with personal protection and emergency response services.

The position emphasizes high customer service standards, clear communication, and the ability to multitask in a dynamic hospital setting, with mandatory compliance to licensing and certification requirements.

jobs.title: Healthcare Security Officer — Patient Safety Champion
jobs.description:
Houston Methodist is seeking a Security Officer to maintain a safe environment for patients, staff and visitors by patrolling hospital premises, monitoring surveillance and access points, and assisting with personal protection and emergency response.

This role requires the ability to communicate effectively, multi-task under pressure, and adhere to HIPAA and safety policies. Applicants should have a high school diploma and security-related experience, plus the licenses listed in the job postings.

jobs.title: Compassionate Security Officer — Southeast Hospital (Day Shift)
jobs.description:
Memorial Hermann Health System is seeking a Security Officer for the Southeast region (days) to help protect patients, visitors, and staff at Memorial Hermann Hospital campuses. The role involves patrolling, controlling access, documenting incidents, and responding to emergencies while adhering to hospital policies.

Qualified candidates will hold a High School Diploma or GED, be Commissioned Security Officers licensed by the Texas DPS, and obtain CPR certification within 90 days.

jobs.title: Hospital Security Officer Safeguard Patients & Staff
jobs.description:
Houston Dose is offering a position for a security role at Memorial Hermann Hospital in Houston, Texas. The role requires monitoring assigned areas for safety, conducting patrols, and responding to emergency situations. Candidates must have a high school diploma and be at least 21 years old. CPR certification and a Commissioned Security Officer license within 90 days are necessary.

The successful applicant will demonstrate a commitment to providing safe and compassionate care to patients, staff, and visitors, ensuring compliance with all hospital policies.
